entities.name: UniProt Q9VPM5
observations: Exact sequence match: 539 aa Drosophila melanogaster protein mushroom body miniature (MBM).
Required for small ribosomal subunit biogenesis in neuroblasts; also implicated in mushroom body development.
Reported in nucleus, nucleolus, and cytoplasm; nuclear in interphase and redistributed to cytoplasm during mitosis.
Contains two annotated CCHC-type zinc-finger regions at residues 354–367 and 371–386; nucleic-acid and zinc-ion binding are annotated.
Sequence is highly low-complexity/disordered, with glycine/arginine-rich and acidic/basic regions; predicted pI 8.76, mass ~58.6 kDa.
